acceptance: Forced stop and natural idle termination (30.1 s observed) restart the worker with grants and counters intact; an interrupted capture is reported as interrupted, never lost or retried; planted secrets appear nowhere in the pack, worker globals, storage, hooked logs or replies, and the packaged scripts contain no logging calls.

negative.fixture: capture of a 50k-node page interrupted by termination; secrets page with password field and token text

security_and_source_permissions: Only user-authorized origins are observed; form values and secret-shaped text never leave the page; no source application server is contacted; bridge and extension commands are origin- and sender-checked.
performance_memory_storage: natural idle termination after 30.1 s with a browser-level DevTools socket only
known_limitations: Attaching Playwright to the worker keeps it alive, so restart tests use ServiceWorker.stopWorker; natural termination is shown separately
